hooks.text: 第一人称挥舞棒球棍迎击不断逼近的Boykisser，击杀换取经验并承受持续上升的压力。
hooks.excerpt: The game places the player in combat with constantly advancing Boykissers while armed with a baseball bat. Defeating Boykissers grants experience and allows progression as the pressure steadily increases.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 升级并非默认开放，必须在单局内完成指定挑战，同时解锁成就与新选项。
hooks.excerpt: Upgrades are not available by default and are unlocked by completing specific challenges during runs. Completing these challenges also grants Achievements that track progress and expand available options.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次生存成绩都会记录并与其他玩家比较，重复挑战用于刷新个人结果和排行榜名次。
hooks.excerpt: Every attempt is recorded and compared with other players. New runs allow results to be improved and rankings to be climbed on the Leaderboard .
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
